name: Story Spine (once upon a time ... until finally)
summary: Follow a character through routine, disruption, a chain of consequences and a climax to a new normal, then name the moral.
references: Kenn Adams, story spine improv exercise (1991)
title_style: Story-beat titles: short phrases that follow the spine, such as 'Every day...' or 'Because of that...'.

sequence.purpose: Once upon a time: who and where.
Because of that: a chain of consequences.
And ever since then: the new normal.

pitfalls: Skipping the routine, so the disruption has no weight.
Consequences that do not follow from each other.
Ending without saying what changed for good.

example.topic: A fictional hospital ward adopting a nurse's handover checklist
outline: Once there was a night-shift nurse named Mara
Every night she copied charts by hand
Until one night a chart was copied wrong
Because of that, she built a checklist
Until finally, the whole ward adopted it
Ever since, no chart has gone missing
Small fixes spread when they come from the floor
